law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 195/2024)
jurisdiction: National Center for Personal Data Protection
key_requirements: GDPR-style lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, 72-hour breach notification, accountability
retention_period: No longer than necessary for the purpose
enforcement_authority: National Center for Personal Data Protection (CNPDCP)
exemptions: Household use; crime-prevention processing under Law 160/2026
notes: Replaced Law 133/2011 (GDPR-aligned); applies since 23 Aug 2026 after 24-month transition
